testSummary.note: Cumulative across V4.1-V5.5. V5.5 added 19 new tests.

supportedClaims: RecoverFP branch generation requires the full 5-epoch update cycle.
Distance and coupling metrics amplify synchronously across epochs (rho ~0.99-1.00).
Omega is downstream of the distance/coupling amplification.
No single RecoverFP stage dominates branch separation.
Branch generation is distributed multi-stage d-to-K amplification.
Freeze-K at any epoch collapses high-branch formation (4-5/5 seeds lost).
Epoch 5 is necessary for full branch development.
conditionalClaims: All results at N=67, 30 seeds. N=69 and N=72 in UMP protocol only.
Freeze-K tested; Freeze-d protocol not executed due to implementation constraints.
Results at V4.1 baseline regime (xi=1.75, K0=1.20, s=0.10).
GM4 (d-to-K feedback) conditionally supported; GM5 (multi-stage) supported.
hypotheses: The d-to-K update subloop is the generative core; Full 5-stage map may be refinable.
Epoch count sensitivity may suggest a critical amplification depth threshold.
d-to-K mutual amplification may be formalizable as a coupled operator.
